g.text: RAILWAY LEVEL CROSSING & TRAIN TRAFFIC CONTROLLER
COMPLETE SYSTEM ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT SCHEMATIC & HARDWARE INTERCONNECT DIAGRAM
Course: UE25EC2302 (Hardware Modelling using Verilog) | 40 Marks PBL
[POWER] DUAL REGULATED POWER SUPPLY & FILTERING NETWORK
⚡ SERVO POWER RAIL: Dedicated +5.0V (Red Wires) isolated from MCU VCC
⚡ SENSOR & LOGIC RAIL: +5.0V from Arduino USB / On-board 5V Pin
All GND pins (Ext Supply GND, Arduino GND, Sensor GND, Servo GND, LED Cathodes) MUST
be bonded into a single COMMON STAR GROUND BUS (0.0V) to prevent floating logic.
Arduino Uno R3 (ATmega328P @ 16 MHz) / Digilent Basys 3 FPGA
TTL Input: V_IL < 0.8V | V_IH > 2.0V • CMOS Output: V_OL < 0.4V | V_OH > 4.2V
• IR Emitter: GaAs LED (940 nm), I_F = 20 mA in series with R_limit = 220 Ω, 1/4W
• Phototransistor: NPN Collector tied to +5V via R_pullup = 10 kΩ
• Threshold Potentiometer: 10 kΩ Multi-turn Cermet Trimmer (V_ref = 2.5V typ)
• Comparator IC: LM393 Dual Differential Comparator (Open-Collector)
• D0 Digital Output: Active-LOW (0.0V when beam interrupted; 5.0V quiescent)
✔ On-board LED indicator with 1 kΩ resistor illuminates on train detection
Mount: 20 cm before crossing on inbound track
Pin 1 (VCC) ➔ +5V Logic Rail | Pin 2 (GND) ➔ Common GND
Pin 3 (OUT) ➔ Arduino Pin D2 (Interrupt INT0) / FPGA [V17]
Mount: Directly across road-rail intersection center
Pin 1 (VCC) ➔ +5V Logic Rail | Pin 2 (GND) ➔ Common GND
Pin 3 (OUT) ➔ Arduino Pin D3 (Interrupt INT1) / FPGA [V16]
Mount: 20 cm past crossing on departure track
Pin 1 (VCC) ➔ +5V Logic Rail | Pin 2 (GND) ➔ Common GND
Pin 3 (OUT) ➔ Arduino Pin D7 / FPGA [W16] (Starts 5s buffer)
Mount: Focused across road lanes over crossing diamond
Pin 1 (VCC) ➔ +5V Logic Rail | Pin 2 (GND) ➔ Common GND
Pin 3 (OUT) ➔ Arduino Pin A1 (or D11) / FPGA [W17]
Instant emergency lockdown: Forces train signal RED + Siren
• Supply: 4.8V to 6.0V DC (External 5V 2A Rail) | Peak Stall: 800 mA each
• PWM Frame: 50.0 Hz (Period T = 20.0 ms) | Angle: 90° (Open) ↔ 0° (Closed)
• Pulse Width: 2.0 ms for 90° (Vertical) | 1.0 ms for 0° (Horizontal Barrier)
Red Wire ➔ Ext +5V Rail | Brown Wire ➔ Common GND
Orange Wire (PWM) ➔ Arduino Pin D9 / FPGA PMOD JB1
Red Wire ➔ Ext +5V Rail | Brown Wire ➔ Common GND
Orange Wire (PWM) ➔ Arduino Pin D10 / FPGA PMOD JB2
[SIGNALS & ALARMS] TRAFFIC LIGHTS, PEDESTRIAN, WIG-WAGS & BUZZER
A. ROAD TRAFFIC LIGHT MASTS (North & South Approaches):
Current-limiting formula: R = (5.0V - V_F) / 15mA = (5.0 - 2.0) / 0.015 = 200 Ω ➔ Standard 220 Ω, 1/4W
RED LED (Stop): Pin D4 ➔ R1 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) | Cathode (-) ➔ GND
YELLOW LED (Caution): Pin D5 ➔ R2 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) | Cathode (-) ➔ GND
GREEN LED (Go): Pin D6 ➔ R3 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) | Cathode (-) ➔ GND
B. PEDESTRIAN CROSSING SIGNALS (Walk / Don't Walk):
WALK GREEN: Pin D11 ➔ R_ped1 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) | Cathode (-) ➔ GND
DON'T WALK RED: Pin A5 ➔ R_ped2 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) | Cathode (-) ➔ GND
C. CROSSBUCK RED WIG-WAG FLASHERS (4x 5mm High-Bright Red LEDs):
Alternating 1.25 Hz cadence (800 ms cycle, 180° out-of-phase during train passage)
• Left Pair (x2 Red LEDs in parallel): Pin D12 ➔ R4 = 220 Ω ➔ Anodes (+)
• Right Pair (x2 Red LEDs in parallel): Pin D13 ➔ R5 = 220 Ω ➔ Anodes (+)
D. RAILWAY TRACK SIGNALS (LOCOMOTIVE ASPECTS - INTERLOCKED):
TRACK GREEN: Pin A2 ➔ R6 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) (Clear ONLY Gate=0°)
TRACK RED: Pin A3 ➔ R7 = 220 Ω ➔ Anode (+) (Halt if Gate>0° | Obstacle)
E. AUDIBLE WARNING BUZZER (5.0V Active Piezo, 85 dB @ 10cm):
• Positive (+) Terminal ➔ Arduino Pin D8 (PWM chime & emergency siren)
• Negative (-) Terminal ➔ Common GND (Current draw: 25 mA nominal)
F. MANUAL EMERGENCY BUTTONS (Tactile SPST Momentary NO):
1. Manual Emergency Stop: Term 1 ➔ +5V | Term 2 ➔ Pin A0 + 10 kΩ R_pd to GND
Pressing injects 5V HIGH pulse, locking barriers and sounding 2.8 kHz siren
2. Gate Tamper Test Button: Term 1 ➔ +5V | Term 2 ➔ Pin A4 + 10 kΩ R_pd to GND
Simulates illegal gate lift attempt; Unit 2 gate-level interlock inhibits motor command
[BILL OF MATERIALS] HARDWARE COMPONENTS SPECIFICATION MATRIX (EXACT VALUES & TOLERANCES)
Metal Film 1/4W Resistors (R1 to R7, R_ped)
In series with all LED Anodes
Pins D4, D5, D6, A2, A3, D11, A5
C1: Alum Electrolytic | C2: Ceramic Disc 104
